use default

recaman() -> Pipe[int] is
    let seen = SET()
    let term mut = 0
    let index mut = 0

    do
        yield term
        seen.add(term)

        index = index + 1

        let back = term - index

        term = if back > 0 /\ !seen.contains(back) then back
               else term + index
               fi
    od
si

let first_fifteen = recaman() |> take(15) |> map(term => "{term}")

write_line("first fifteen terms:")
write_line("  {first_fifteen |> join(" ")}")

let seen = SET()
let duplicate mut = 0
let wanted = SET()
let position mut = 0
let all_reached mut = 0

for term in recaman() do
    if duplicate == 0 /\ !seen.add(term) then
        duplicate = term
    fi

    if term <= 1_000 then
        wanted.add(term)
    fi

    if all_reached == 0 /\ wanted.count == 1_001 then
        all_reached = position
    fi

    if duplicate != 0 /\ all_reached != 0 then
        break
    fi

    position = position + 1
od

write_line("the first duplicated term is {duplicate}")
write_line("every integer from 0 to 1000 has appeared "
           "by term {all_reached}")
